mapper.select: select l.id, l.operate_emp_id as operateEmpId, l.operate_time as operateTime, l.class_name as className, l.method_name as methodName, l.method_params as methodParams, l.return_value as returnValue, l.cost_time as costTime, e.name as operateEmpName from operate_log l left join emp e on l.operate_emp_id = e.id order by l.operate_time desc
